verdict.rationale: Galileo ships an in-product AI Assistant for troubleshooting agentic systems. Its official MCP server lets AI IDEs such as Cursor and Copilot drive core operations, including datasets, experiments and prompt templates, so users can work through natural-language requests, but the conversational layer comes from the external IDE agent. Separately, metric feedback can be given in natural language. missing for 10: documentation that the AI Assistant can execute product operations beyond troubleshooting, a first-party natural-language command interface covering the whole product, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Troubleshoot your agentic system with the AI Assistant.
With MCP, you can access Galileo's capabilities directly from your development environment, including: Creating and managing datasets, Running experiments, Setting up prompt templates
This allows you to continuously provide feedback in natural language that automatically improves the metrics
